title: Nycs Garba X Bollywood At 230 Fifth Rooftop
description: Immerse in the Vibrancy of NYC's Garba X Bollywood at 230 Fifth Rooftop
long_description:
Immerse in the Vibrancy of NYC's Garba X Bollywood at 230 Fifth Rooftop
Mark your calendars for the 10th of October, 2026. The city that never sleeps will dance to the rhythm of Bollywood and the traditional Gujarati folk dance Garba. NYC's Garba X Bollywood at 230 Fifth Rooftop promises an unforgettable night of music, dance, food, and drinks. This multilingual event will feature music in Hindi, Telugu, Punjabi, and English. It's not just a party, it's a melting pot of diverse cultures, languages, and traditions. Come and experience the magic of Bollywood and the exhilaration of Garba under the starlit New York sky.
Experience the Magic with Tamasha Nights by DJ Browny
While the artist for the NYC's Garba X Bollywood at 230 Fifth Rooftop is yet to be disclosed, the event is organized by none other than Tamasha Nights by DJ Browny. Known for their electrifying events, DJ Browny never fails to create a memorable experience for their audience. So, get ready to sway and twirl to some of the best Bollywood and regional tunes.
230 Fifth Rooftop Bar - An Iconic Venue for an Iconic Event
The event will be held at the stunning 230 Fifth Rooftop Bar, located at 1150 Broadway, New York, NY, United States. Known for its breathtaking views of the Manhattan skyline, the venue is a perfect backdrop for a night of Bollywood and Garba. The venue is easily accessible and is surrounded by a number of well-known Indian restaurants, allowing you to indulge in delectable Indian cuisine before or after the event. With ample parking and top-notch safety measures in place, your convenience and safety are assured.
Secure Your Tickets for an Unforgettable Experience
Don't miss out on this unique cultural extravaganza. Choose from General Admission tickets priced at $30.00, or opt for Skip-The-Line Admission at $35.00 for a seamless entry experience. Secure your spot now and prepare to groove to the rhythms of Bollywood and Garba at NYC's Garba X Bollywood at 230 Fifth Rooftop.
